resources.string: Your next BorrowBuddy return with a live countdown, plus pending requests, unread chats and fines. Tap through to the loan or straight to Browse.
Parcel, the BorrowBuddy mascot, keeps an eye on your loans. Its face and speech bubble change when something is due, overdue or new.
A pocket boarding pass: how long until your next loan is due back, and what needs your attention.
